title: OTA signed manifest
description: The manifest served to devices as <cdn>/<platform>/<appVersion>/manifest.json (canonical JSON: sorted keys, no whitespace; detached Ed25519 signature in manifest.json.sig). DESIGN.md section 6; TypeScript type `Manifest` in packages/ota-core/src/types.ts. Producer: ota-cli (applyDeploy/applyRollout/... in ota-core). Consumers: the native SDK, ota-cli verify. NOT expressible here (enforced by validateManifest() in ota-core): ranges inside one entry list must not overlap (sum of shares <= 1), ids unique across the whole manifest, requiresHost must equal a mainBundle entry id, range start <= end.

platform.description: Platform this manifest is for. Android and iOS manifests of one state version share `version` but differ in hashes.

appVersion.description: Binary release line this manifest targets, e.g. "11.9.0".

patchAlgoVer.description: Patch algorithm version the device must support, e.g. "v1" (HDiffPatch single compressed diff, zstd).

version.description: Monotonic per (platform, appVersion). Replay/downgrade protection: devices never accept a lower version.

ttlSec.description: How long a device may cache this manifest before re-fetching, in seconds (1..86400).

mainBundle.description: The host bundle (the 'host' unit): patches that apply to the embedded host bundle.

baseHash.description: Hash of the embedded host bundle these patches apply to.

units.description: Per-unit patch ladders. A unit appears only once it has had at least one patch; unitName must be unique (not expressible).

unitName.description: Unit name as in units.config.json, e.g. "cabs".

baseHash.description: Hash of the embedded unit bundle this unit's patches apply to.

entries.description: Ladder order: index 0 is the newest patch.

id.description: `<unit>-pr<N>` (N = ota-deployments PR number). Same for both platforms. Unique across the manifest (not expressible).

patchUrl.description: Absolute URL of the patch file on the CDN.

hash.description: sha256 of the BUILT result (patch applied to the embedded unit); verified on the device after applying.

updateType.description: `patch`: delta against the embedded bundle. `full`: a complete bundle encoded as a patch against an empty file.

prefixItems.description: End (exclusive) of the bucket interval. Must be >= start (not expressible).

range.description: Half-open interval [start,end) over a device's bucket in [0,1). Absent = [0,1) (100%). [0,0] = deployed at 0%.

requiresHost.description: Escape hatch for coupled releases: only usable if the VM booted with the mainBundle entry of this id. Must equal a mainBundle entry id (not expressible).
